title: Segmentation fault when using Unite grep

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
I recompiled nvim using its PKGBUILD: https://git.archlinux.org/svntogit/community.git/tree/trunk?h=packages/neovim
I only set -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug to make sure backtraces are nicer and disabled stripping (default behavior in ArchLinux).
- `nvim --version`:

NVIM 0.1.5
Build type: Debug
Compilation: /usr/bin/cc -g -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic -O2 -pipe -fstack-protector --param=ssp-buffer-size=4 -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -Wconversion -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=1 -g -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Wno-unused-parameter -Wstrict-prototypes -std=gnu99 -Wvla -fstack-protector-strong -fdiagnostics-color=auto -DINCLUDE_GENERATED_DECLARATIONS -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -D_GNU_SOURCE -I/home/bz/prg/src/other/editor/nvim/src/build/config -I/home/bz/prg/src/other/editor/nvim/src/neovim-0.1.5/src -I/usr/include -I/usr/include -I/usr/include -I/usr/include -I/usr/include -I/usr/include -I/usr/include -I/home/bz/prg/src/other/editor/nvim/src/build/src/nvim/auto -I/home/bz/prg/src/other/editor/nvim/src/build/include
Compiled by bz@boltx64

Optional features included (+) or not (-): +acl   +iconv    +jemalloc +tui  
For differences from Vim, see :help vim-differences

   system vimrc file: "$VIM/sysinit.vim"
  fall-back for $VIM: "/usr/share/nvim"
- Vim (version: ) 7.4 Included patches: 1-2143. **I could not make vim segfault in this scenario**
- Operating system/version: ArchLinux (remote)
- Terminal name/version: terminator 0.96 (client, on Ubuntu 12.04)
- `$TERM`: screen-256color
- tmux: tmux 2.2 (remote)
### Actual behaviour

neovim segfaults when I perform Unite grep and cancel the search using `Ctrl-C`.
### Expected behaviour

Unite should cancel the search without segfaulting.
### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

Segfault happens when I search over my project. For the purpose of reproducibility I've managed to reproduce the issue when I search in files of the plugins I'm using. Sorry this isn't exactly minimal set of files, but the segfault happens rather ofter on these files (not 100% every time, unfortunately). Sometimes I have to run the command about 5-6 times before it crashes.

``` bash
mkdir nvim-segfault && cd nvim-segfault

mkdir -p ~/.cache/dein/repos/github.com/Shougo
git clone https://github.com/Shougo/dein.vim ~/.cache/dein/repos/github.com/Shougo/dein.vim

wget -O repos.txt http://sprunge.us/JKOX
for f in `cat repos.txt `; do echo ">> $f"; git clone "https://github.com/$f"; done

wget -O min.vim http://sprunge.us/RSTK
nvim -N -u min.vim -n -c "Unite grep:.::def"
```

After that, while search is still running, I occasionally press arrow keys, and if I press `Ctrl-C`, neovim often segfaults at this point with a slight delay.

Here are several backtraces that I have managed to save:

[http://sprunge.us/KiYf](http://sprunge.us/KiYf)
[http://sprunge.us/CSLX](http://sprunge.us/CSLX)
[http://sprunge.us/ZSdi](http://sprunge.us/ZSdi)

I can share whole core dumps if necessary.

I'm slightly hesitant whether I should have reported this issue to Unite repo, but I figured plugins should not crash the editor. Maybe @Shougo knows more about this behavior.
# Appendix

minimal [vimrc](http://sprunge.us/RSTK):

``` vim
set runtimepath+=~/.cache/dein/repos/github.com/Shougo/dein.vim
if &compatible
  set nocompatible
endif
call dein#begin('~/.cache/dein-segfault')
call dein#add('Shougo/dein.vim', {'rtp': ''})
call dein#add('Shougo/vimproc.vim', {'build': 'make'})
call dein#add('Shougo/unite.vim')
call dein#end()
if dein#check_install()
    call dein#install()
endif

filetype plugin indent on
syntax enable
set nocompatible
```
